question: List customer names and emails for customers in Bangalore
broken_sql: SELECT customer_name, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Bangalore';
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE LOWER(city) = 'bangalore' LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated customer_name column instead of first_name and last_name

question: Show total order amount and customer ID for order 5
broken_sql: SELECT user_id, order_total FROM orders WHERE order_id = 5;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, discount_amount, shipping_cost FROM orders WHERE order_id = 5;
description: Hallucinated user_id and order_total on orders table

question: List products with price and available stock
broken_sql: SELECT name, item_price, inventory_count FROM products LIMIT 10;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price, stock_quantity FROM products LIMIT 10;
description: Hallucinated item_price and inventory_count instead of price and stock_quantity

question: Show payments with customer name and payment method
broken_sql: SELECT p.payment_id, c.full_name, p.payment_method FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.payment_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, p.payment_method FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated full_name on joined customer table

question: Find products belonging to category ID 2
broken_sql: SELECT product_name, category FROM products WHERE category = 2;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, category_id FROM products WHERE category_id = 2 LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated product_name and category instead of name and category_id

question: Show refund amount and return description
broken_sql: SELECT refund_amount, return_reason FROM returns LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT refund_amount, reason FROM returns LIMIT 50;

question: List all registered customers from India
broken_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM users WHERE country = 'India';
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE LOWER(country) = 'india' LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated table 'users' instead of 'customers'

question: Show all payments with amount greater than 1000
broken_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount FROM transactions WHERE amount > 1000;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount FROM payments WHERE amount > 1000 LIMIT 50;

question: List items and product prices in the catalog
broken_sql: SELECT item_id, title, cost FROM items LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price FROM products LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated table 'items' instead of 'products'

question: Show product categories and names
broken_sql: SELECT category_name FROM product_categories LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name FROM categories LIMIT 50;
description: Hallucinated table 'product_categories' instead of 'categories'

question: Count total orders by status along with customer ID
broken_sql: SELECT status, customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
simulated_error: column "orders.customer_id" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status, customer_id LIMIT 50;
description: Non-aggregated column customer_id omitted from GROUP BY

question: Show total spending by city and country
broken_sql: SELECT c.city, c.country, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.city LIMIT 50;
simulated_error: column "c.country" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.city, c.country, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.city, c.country LIMIT 50;
description: Column country omitted from GROUP BY clause in multi-column aggregation

question: Show product category name and average product price
broken_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.name AS product_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
simulated_error: column "p.name" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
description: Superfluous non-aggregated product name in category summary

question: Find all orders placed in 2024
broken_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date = 2024 LIMIT 50;
simulated_error: operator does not exist: timestamp without time zone = integer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 LIMIT 50;
description: Timestamp equality comparison with raw integer year

question: Show payments where amount is zero
broken_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount FROM payments WHERE amount = 'none' LIMIT 50;
simulated_error: invalid input syntax for type numeric: "none"
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount FROM payments WHERE amount = 0 OR amount IS NULL LIMIT 50;
description: String literal comparison against numeric amount column

question: List customers registered after January 1st 2023
broken_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date > 20230101 LIMIT 50;
simulated_error: operator does not exist: date > integer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2023-01-01' LIMIT 50;
description: Date comparison with raw integer literal instead of ISO string

question: Show customer first names and order IDs
broken_sql: SELECT c.first_name, o.order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, o.order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LIMIT 50;
description: JOIN clause missing the ON join predicate

question: List products with price and stock
broken_sql: SELECT name, price, stock_quantity, FROM products LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price, stock_quantity FROM products LIMIT 50;
description: Trailing comma in SELECT column projection

question: Count completed orders grouped by customer
broken_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE LOWER(status) = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id LIMIT 50;
description: WHERE clause erroneously placed after GROUP BY clause

question: Show order item quantities with product names
broken_sql: SELECT oi.order_id, p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p LIMIT 50;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT oi.order_id, p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LIMIT 50;
description: INNER JOIN missing ON predicate
